q: The f-invariant of Bowen (2010) is a more refined invariant for free group actions that takes into account the tree structure. It equals sofic entropy when computed with a specific sofic approximation coming from random homomorphisms into:
opts: The free group itself via Schreier coset graphs
exp: Bowen's f-invariant uses Schreier graphs (coset graphs) of finite-index subgroups of the free group as the sofic approximation. The f-invariant can be strictly different from hΣ for other sofic approximations, showing sofic entropy depends on the choice of Σ for non-amenable groups.
